setttings_timestamp_format_text: The way that timestamps in time tracker tables should be displayed. Uses
setttings_csvDelimiter_text: The delimiter character that should be used when copying a tracker table as CSV. For example, some languages use a semicolon instead of a comma.
setttings_fineGrainedDurations_text: Whether durations should include days, months and years. If this is disabled, additional time units will be displayed as part of the hours.
setttings_timestampDurations_text: Whether durations should be displayed in a timestamp format (12:15:01) rather than the default duration format (12h 15m 1s).
setttings_reverseSegmentOrder_text: Whether older tracker segments should be displayed towards the bottom of the tracker, rather than the top.
setttings_fileName_text: Name or path to file to insert new time trackers. Allowed format syntax: '/folder/{{DATE(YYYY-DDD)}}'
setttings_createFile: Create file if it doesnt't exist
setttings_writeToBottom_text: Put value at the bottom of the file - otherwise at the top
setttings_insertAfter_text: Insert value after specified line. Accepts format syntax.
